page.notes: Greek headword spellings and several page references are uncertain at this scan's quality; marked [?] where the letters were not clearly legible. "Subroftranus" is copied as printed. The title line's Greek letters at the right edge are partly visible only. Many Greek words are doubtful at this scan resolution and are marked [?]; accents and breathings are uncertain throughout. The title is cut at the left, so only "S", "INDEX", "NO MINV M" and "E R V M." are visible, and the head is given as the visible fragment. The lines are in the order of the column, with page references kept on each line.
